title: ARV usage request
description: The input of record_usage and the body of POST {usage_url}. Names a moment by moment_uri, or by asset_id with start_ms and end_ms.

moment_id.description: Optional cross-check. Must equal the id recomputed from the range. Cannot name a moment alone.

action.description: The use, for example segment_display, clip or quote.

served_to.description: Self-asserted. The origin may record it; the receipt's served_to.agent is always the verified caller or unverified.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. The caller's key for this report. A repeat by the same caller, for the same moment, action and key, within the origin's dedupe window, returns the original receipt and records no new use. Send a new key for each separate use and the same key on retry.
